description: This is a unit test class for the RetrieveAcl class, testing its immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and creation from JSON.

classes.name: RetrieveAclTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RetrieveAcl, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and creation from JSON.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the RetrieveAcl class is immutable and that the ThingId class used within it is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests that the RetrieveAcl class correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveAcl instance with a null string ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveAcl instance with a null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: jsonSerializationWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that a RetrieveAcl instance serializes to JSON correctly.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a RetrieveAcl instance from a valid JSON string.
